_meta.what: Korean biotech and pharmaceutical companies with broker research in our sample: per-company target-price distribution and latest close.
_meta.rule: KSIC code on the DART company register starts with 21 (pharmaceuticals, medicinal chemicals and medical supplies) or is 70113 (medical and pharmaceutical research and development); plus companies named in namedAdditions.

namedAdditions.reason: Filed under KSIC 7011 (natural-science research) rather than the narrower 70113, but its business report filed with DART in March 2025 describes a single operating segment, new drugs.

_meta.researchSource: Broker reports listed on Naver Finance's research board and on brokers' own websites, collected by SeoulMarkets (archive/index/research.ndjson). Analyst names partly matched from Hankyung Consensus where date, firm and ticker matched exactly one report.
_meta.priceSource: Financial Services Commission stock price data (data.go.kr 15094808), daily close.
_meta.industrySource: DART company register (Financial Supervisory Service), industry code field.
_meta.order: Most firms with a stated target first; then most reports; then ticker.
_meta.builtBy: scripts/build-korea-sector-targets.mjs — do not edit by hand
